candidates.hook: Guard kneels and slips a small loaf of bread through the bars, then whispers, “Because no one should die hungry.”
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana bites the bread and whispers “Alexander…”, leaving us wondering if she’ll be saved before her execution.
candidates.why: Shows a compassionate act that instantly grabs attention and raises the stakes of her fate.

candidates.hook: Juliana declares defiantly, “I will not give them my husband.”
candidates.cliffhanger: She hears distant wedding bells and whispers “Then I suppose I’m next,” cutting just before her hopeful smile, leaving her fate unknown.
candidates.why: Combines bold defiance with an ominous wedding bell, pulling viewers into the looming execution.

candidates.hook: Guard urgently whispers, “Eat it before they see,” as he slips the bread.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana, starving, asks “What if I die here?” and we cut before she decides to act.
candidates.why: Urgent whisper creates tension; her desperate question leaves the outcome hanging.

moments.desc: Guard kneels, slips a loaf of bread through the cell bars and whispers, “Because no one should die hungry.”
Juliana, startled, whispers “Bells.” as distant wedding bells begin tolling.
Juliana defiantly says, “I will not give them my husband.”
Juliana prays quietly, “Keep him safe,” establishing her loyalty to Alexander.
